summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, reporting transactions under the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme, announced July 22, 2026, running July 23 to October 26, 2026. From July 27-31, Equinor bought 660,000 own shares at a weighted average price of NOK 382.2365, totaling about NOK 252.3 million. Accumulated under the tranche, Equinor repurchased 880,000 shares at an average of NOK 384.5493, costing NOK 338.4 million. Post-transaction, Equinor holds 15,135,775 own shares (0.63% of share capital) including share savings programme shares, or 4,414,975 (0.18%) excluding them. This is a routine issuer buyback under EU Market Abuse Regulation and Norwegian Securities Trading Act disclosure obligations. What to watch: continued periodic buy-back updates through the tranche's October end, which could support share price.
